response_windows.law: ustawa o podatku od spadków i darowizn art. 6 ust. 1 pkt 1, art. 9 ust. 1, art. 17a ust. 1 (as amended by Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1854, for decisions and certificates from 7 Jan 2026)

recurring.title: Annual income tax return (PIT) for the previous year

recurring.title: Property tax instalment (podatek od nieruchomości); a yearly amount up to PLN 100 is paid once, by 15 March

recurring.law: ustawa o podatkach i opłatach lokalnych art. 6 ust. 7 and 11a

recurring.title: 800+ child benefit application for the period from 1 June (filed by 30 April: paid without a gap from June)

recurring.law: ustawa o pomocy państwa w wychowywaniu dzieci art. 13 ust. 5, art. 18 ust. 1 and 2, art. 21 ust. 3 and 4

recurring.title: Payers' information forms for last year should have arrived (PIT-11, PIT-11A, PIT-40A, PIT-8C)
recurring.applies_when: someone in the household had wages, contract income, a pension or investment income last year

recurring.law: ustawa o podatku dochodowym od osób fizycznych art. 45cd ust. 1, 2, 4 and 5

recurring.title: Informing the head of the district primary school that the pre-school year or school obligation is fulfilled abroad or at a foreign embassy school

PCC on a car bought by a person with a disability (ustawa o PCC art. 2 pkt 1 lit. b)
any penalty for a late address notice for the vehicle registration certificate (art. 140mb has none; Kodeks wykroczeń art. 97 unclear)
the funeral allowance from 1 Mar 2027, which depends on 2026 inflation
the first waste-fee declaration after an occupied property changes owner

retention.title: Tax returns, payers' forms (PIT-11 and similar) and proof of reliefs
retention.title_pl: Zeznania podatkowe, informacje od płatników i dowody ulg
retention.from: the end of the calendar year in which the tax was due (for an annual PIT return, the year of the 30 April deadline); for a relief carried forward, the tax for the last year in which it is deducted
retention.note: The tax becomes time-barred 5 years after the end of the year it was due. The formal duty to keep records for that time (Ordynacja podatkowa art. 86 § 1) binds those who keep tax books; see the pack section Correcting a return, refunds and keeping papers.

retention.title: Energy, gas and water bills with proof of payment
retention.title_pl: Rachunki za prąd, gaz i wodę z potwierdzeniami zapłaty
retention.from: the end of the calendar year in which the bill was due
retention.note: Suggestion covering the longest period that can apply. Claims from sales by a business, which include energy and water, expire after 2 years (art. 554 with 555); claims for periodic payments after 3 years, ending on 31 December (art. 118). After that a claim generally cannot be enforced against a consumer (art. 117 § 2¹, with the court's exception in art. 117¹).

retention.title: Phone, internet and TV bills with proof of payment
retention.title_pl: Rachunki za telefon, internet i telewizję z potwierdzeniami zapłaty
retention.from: the end of the calendar year in which the bill was due
retention.law: Kodeks cywilny art. 118; Prawo komunikacji elektronicznej art. 381
retention.note: Suggestion. The Supreme Court applied the 3-year period of art. 118 to telephone charges under the earlier telecom act (III CZP 20/09 of 7.05.2009). A complaint suspends the limitation until the complaint procedure ends (Prawo komunikacji elektronicznej art. 381).

retention.title: Receipts, invoices and other proof of purchase of goods
retention.title_pl: Paragony, faktury i inne dowody zakupu towarów
retention.law: ustawa o prawach konsumenta art. 43c ust. 1; Kodeks cywilny art. 577 § 4
retention.note: The trader's liability for lack of conformity lasts 2 years from delivery, or longer if the stated shelf life is longer. Keep longer for the length of a voluntary guarantee (2 years unless it states otherwise) and until any complaint is settled.

retention.title: Building works contract, acceptance record (protokół odbioru) and invoices
retention.title_pl: Umowa o roboty budowlane, protokół odbioru i faktury
retention.law: Kodeks cywilny art. 568 § 1 and 2, with art. 638 § 1 and art. 656 § 1
retention.note: Defects of a building must be found within 5 years of handover; a repair claim expires 1 year after the defect is found, for a consumer not before the 5 years end. Keep longer while a defect claim is pending. Invoices for improvements may also matter for tax on a later sale (see notarial deeds).

retention.title: Work certificates (świadectwa pracy), employers' pay certificates and employment contracts
retention.title_pl: Świadectwa pracy, zaświadczenia o zatrudnieniu i wynagrodzeniu, umowy o pracę
retention.note: No period is set for the employee. ZUS accepts these documents as evidence of past work and pay (pension proceedings regulation, t.j. Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1055, § 21 and 22), including for the initial capital for work before 1999 (ustawa o emeryturach i rentach z FUS art. 173 ust. 1). An employer keeps its files only 10 years after the end of the year the employment ended (Kodeks pracy art. 94 pkt 9b).

retention.title: Insurance policies and claim correspondence
retention.title_pl: Polisy ubezpieczeniowe i korespondencja w sprawie szkód
retention.from: the end of the cover, or receipt of the insurer's written decision on a reported claim
retention.note: Suggestion based on the 3-year limitation of claims under an insurance contract, which runs from the claim becoming due and restarts after the insurer's written decision on a reported claim or event.

retention.title: Liability (OC) insurance policies
retention.note: Suggestion. A claim for damage caused by a tort expires 3 years after the injured person learns of the damage and who is liable, but no later than 10 years after the event; longer periods apply after a crime and for personal injury. An injured person's claim against the liability insurer follows the same limitation (art. 819 § 3).

retention.title: Notarial deeds and title documents for a home, with invoices for improvements
retention.title_pl: Akty notarialne i dokumenty własności nieruchomości wraz z fakturami za nakłady
retention.note: The notary keeps the original deed and issues further extracts (wypis) to the parties and their successors; an extract has the force of the original (Prawo o notariacie art. 95, 109, 110 § 1). A sale within 5 years from the end of the year of purchase or construction is taxed, and only documented purchase costs and value-adding outlays count (ustawa o PIT art. 10 ust. 1 pkt 8, art. 22 ust. 6c).

retention.title: Court decisions and court settlements
retention.note: A claim confirmed by a final court ruling or a court settlement expires after 6 years, and future periodic payments under it after 3 years (Kodeks cywilny art. 125 § 1).

retention.title: Loan agreements, repayment schedules and the lender's confirmation of full repayment
retention.title_pl: Umowy kredytu lub pożyczki, harmonogramy spłat i potwierdzenie całkowitej spłaty
retention.from: the end of the calendar year of the final payment
retention.note: Suggestion. The general limitation period is 6 years and ends on 31 December; claims connected with running a business, such as the lender's, expire after 3 years (art. 118).

retention.title: Bank statements
retention.from: the period of the item they prove
retention.note: No period is set for a household. Keep a statement while it is the proof for another item in this list (a tax relief, a bill, a loan). Banks keep transaction records for 5 years after the customer relationship ends (ustawa o przeciwdziałaniu praniu pieniędzy oraz finansowaniu terroryzmu art. 49 ust. 1).

tasks.title: Collect the registration certificate, the test certificate if needed, and the OC confirmation
tasks.title_pl: Odbierz dowód rejestracyjny, zaświadczenie o badaniu technicznym (jeśli potrzebne) i potwierdzenie zawarcia OC
tasks.law: Prawo o ruchu drogowym art. 78 ust. 1; ustawa o ubezpieczeniach obowiązkowych, UFG i PBUK art. 32 ust. 1
tasks.note: The test certificate is needed when the registration certificate shows no current test date.

tasks.title: Keep the purchase agreement or invoice
tasks.title_pl: Zachowaj umowę kupna lub fakturę
tasks.law: Prawo o ruchu drogowym art. 72 ust. 1 pkt 1
tasks.note: It is the proof of ownership for registration.

tasks.title: Decide on the seller's OC: keep it or end it in writing
tasks.title_pl: Zdecyduj o OC sprzedającego: kontynuacja albo pisemne wypowiedzenie
tasks.law: ustawa o ubezpieczeniach obowiązkowych, UFG i PBUK art. 31 ust. 1 and 6
tasks.note: A new OC must start no later than the day the ended one stops.

tasks.title: No OC from the seller: take out OC on the purchase day
tasks.title_pl: Brak OC sprzedającego: zawrzyj umowę OC w dniu zakupu
tasks.law: ustawa o ubezpieczeniach obowiązkowych, UFG i PBUK art. 31 ust. 3
tasks.note: Before driving at the latest.

tasks.title: Keeping the seller's OC: give the insurer the facts for recalculating the premium
tasks.title_pl: Kontynuacja OC sprzedającego: przekaż ubezpieczycielowi dane do ponownej kalkulacji składki
tasks.law: ustawa o ubezpieczeniach obowiązkowych, UFG i PBUK art. 31 ust. 2, art. 32 ust. 4
tasks.note: No deadline; the buyer owes the premium from the purchase date.

tasks.title: Hand over the registration certificate, the test certificate if needed, and the OC confirmation
tasks.title_pl: Przekaż dowód rejestracyjny, zaświadczenie o badaniu technicznym (jeśli potrzebne) i potwierdzenie zawarcia OC
tasks.law: Prawo o ruchu drogowym art. 78 ust. 1; ustawa o ubezpieczeniach obowiązkowych, UFG i PBUK art. 32 ust. 1
tasks.note: The test certificate is needed when the registration certificate shows no current test date.

tasks.title: Keep the sale agreement and attach a copy to the starosta notice
tasks.title_pl: Zachowaj umowę sprzedaży; kopię dołącz do zawiadomienia starosty
tasks.law: vehicle registration regulation (Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1709) § 15 ust. 1; ustawa o ubezpieczeniach obowiązkowych, UFG i PBUK art. 32 ust. 3 and 4
tasks.note: Its date fixes when liability and the premium passed to the buyer.

tasks.title: Check voluntary policies such as AC
tasks.title_pl: Sprawdź ubezpieczenia dobrowolne, np. AC
tasks.law: Kodeks cywilny art. 823 § 1 and 3
tasks.note: They pass to the buyer only with the insurer's consent, unless the terms say otherwise; otherwise they end at the sale.

tasks.title: Sold within 6 months of buying: include the income in the annual PIT return
tasks.title_pl: Sprzedaż przed upływem pół roku od zakupu: wykaż przychód w zeznaniu rocznym
tasks.law: ustawa o PIT art. 10 ust. 1 pkt 8 lit. d
tasks.note: Six months counted from the end of the month of purchase; a sale outside a business.

tasks.title: Update the address with the tax office
tasks.title_pl: Zaktualizuj adres w urzędzie skarbowym
tasks.law: ustawa o zasadach ewidencji i identyfikacji podatników i płatników art. 9 ust. 1d
tasks.note: In the next tax return or other tax document, or on ZAP-3; from 1 Jan 2027 only a return or ZAP-3 (Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1270). No deadline.

tasks.title: Waste fee: new declaration when the data behind the fee change
tasks.title_pl: Opłata za odpady: nowa deklaracja po zmianie danych, np. liczby mieszkańców
tasks.law: ustawa o utrzymaniu czystości i porządku w gminach art. 6m ust. 2, art. 2 ust. 3
tasks.note: By the 10th day of the month after the change; in a block of separately owned flats the housing community or cooperative files it.

tasks.title: Tell insurers about the move where the policy requires it
tasks.title_pl: Zgłoś przeprowadzkę ubezpieczycielom, jeśli wymaga tego umowa
tasks.law: Kodeks cywilny art. 815 § 2
tasks.note: Promptly; not for life insurance.

tasks.title: Identity card: no new card for a move
tasks.title_pl: Dowód osobisty: przeprowadzka nie wymaga wymiany
tasks.law: ustawa o dowodach osobistych art. 12 ust. 1, art. 12a ust. 1, art. 46 ust. 1 pkt 2
tasks.note: Cards issued under the act in force show no address.

tasks.title: Driving licence: the current pattern shows no address
tasks.title_pl: Prawo jazdy: obecny wzór nie zawiera adresu
tasks.law: ustawa o kierujących pojazdami art. 18 ust. 1; driving licence pattern regulation (Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1072) annex 1 pt 2.1.4
tasks.note: Changes to data shown on the licence go to the starosta within 30 days.

tasks.title: Give the new address to the bank, the employer, schools and other contacts
tasks.title_pl: Podaj nowy adres bankowi, pracodawcy, szkole i innym podmiotom
tasks.note: No statutory deadline.

tasks.title: PESEL number and registered residence follow from the birth registration
tasks.title_pl: Numer PESEL i zameldowanie dziecka następują z urzędu
tasks.law: ustawa o ewidencji ludności art. 16 ust. 1, art. 17 ust. 1 pkt 1, art. 29
tasks.note: No separate application.

tasks.title: Request paternity leave from the employer
tasks.title_pl: Złóż wniosek o urlop ojcowski
tasks.law: Kodeks pracy art. 182³ § 2
tasks.note: At least 7 days before the leave starts.

tasks.title: Request parental leave from the employer
tasks.title_pl: Złóż wniosek o urlop rodzicielski
tasks.law: Kodeks pracy art. 182¹a § 1 and 4, art. 182¹c, art. 182¹d § 1
tasks.note: At least 21 days before the leave starts; up to 5 parts until the end of the year the child turns 6.

tasks.title: Premature or hospitalised baby: request supplementary maternity leave
tasks.title_pl: Wcześniak lub dziecko w szpitalu: złóż wniosek o uzupełniający urlop macierzyński
tasks.law: Kodeks pracy art. 180² § 1 and 4
tasks.note: At least 21 days before maternity leave ends.

tasks.title: Check-up and vaccination schedules
tasks.title_pl: Terminarz bilansów zdrowia i szczepień
tasks.law: regulation on guaranteed primary care services (t.j. Dz.U. 2023 poz. 1427) annex 1 part III; ustawa o zapobieganiu oraz zwalczaniu zakażeń i chorób zakaźnych u ludzi art. 17 ust. 11
tasks.note: The vaccination programme for each year is announced by 31 October of the year before.

tasks.title: Waste fee: new declaration if the fee depends on the number of residents
tasks.title_pl: Opłata za odpady: nowa deklaracja, jeśli opłata zależy od liczby mieszkańców
tasks.law: ustawa o utrzymaniu czystości i porządku w gminach art. 6m ust. 2, art. 2 ust. 3
tasks.note: By the 10th day of the month after the change.

tasks.title: Give the new employer a PIT-2 statement
tasks.title_pl: Złóż nowemu pracodawcy oświadczenie PIT-2
tasks.law: ustawa o PIT art. 31a ust. 2, 5 and 7, art. 31b ust. 1 to 3
tasks.note: Applied from the month after it arrives at the latest; up to three payers, at 1/12, 1/24 or 1/36 each.

tasks.title: PPK at the new employer: enrolment or written opt-out
tasks.title_pl: PPK u nowego pracodawcy: zapis albo pisemna rezygnacja
tasks.law: ustawa o pracowniczych planach kapitałowych art. 15 ust. 1 and 2, art. 16 ust. 1 and 2, art. 23 ust. 2, 4 and 6
tasks.note: Enrolment no later than the 10th day of the month after 3 months of employment; opting out stops contributions from that month.

tasks.title: No new job: register at the county labour office
tasks.title_pl: Brak nowej pracy: rejestracja w powiatowym urzędzie pracy
tasks.law: ustawa o rynku pracy i służbach zatrudnienia art. 218 ust. 1, art. 219 ust. 1 pkt 1, art. 220 ust. 1 pkt 5 and ust. 2 pkt 3
tasks.note: Benefit from the day of registration; none after resigning with notice, and a 90-day wait after an agreed termination, with the listed exceptions.

tasks.title: Work certificate not issued: claim it in the labour court
tasks.title_pl: Brak świadectwa pracy: pozew do sądu pracy
tasks.law: Kodeks pracy art. 97¹ § 1 and 3
tasks.note: At any time before the claim is time-barred.

tasks.title: Funeral costs from the deceased's bank accounts
tasks.title_pl: Zwrot kosztów pogrzebu z rachunków zmarłego
tasks.law: Prawo bankowe art. 55 ust. 1 pkt 1 and ust. 2
tasks.note: Paid on the bills, within customary costs; outside the estate.

tasks.title: Disposition on death at the deceased's bank
tasks.title_pl: Dyspozycja wkładem na wypadek śmierci
tasks.law: Prawo bankowe art. 56 ust. 1, 2 and 5, art. 56a ust. 2
tasks.note: To the named spouse, ascendants, descendants or siblings, up to 20 times the average monthly wage; the bank informs them.

tasks.title: Survivor's pension application to ZUS
tasks.title_pl: Wniosek o rentę rodzinną
tasks.law: ustawa o emeryturach i rentach z FUS art. 65 ust. 1, art. 95a ust. 1 and 2, art. 129 ust. 1 and 2
tasks.note: Filed in the month of the death or the next month: paid from the day of death.

tasks.title: Confirm the heirs: court decision or notarial certificate of succession
tasks.title_pl: Stwierdzenie nabycia spadku albo akt poświadczenia dziedziczenia
tasks.law: Kodeks cywilny art. 1025 § 1, art. 1026
tasks.note: Not within 6 months of the death unless all known heirs have made their statements.

tasks.title: Find the deceased's bank accounts
tasks.title_pl: Uzyskaj informację o rachunkach zmarłego
tasks.law: Prawo bankowe art. 92ba ust. 1 and 2, art. 92bc ust. 1
tasks.note: For a person with a legal title to the estate, through a bank, from the central account information.

tasks.title: The deceased's OC passes to the heirs
tasks.title_pl: OC zmarłego przechodzi na spadkobierców
tasks.law: ustawa o ubezpieczeniach obowiązkowych, UFG i PBUK art. 31 ust. 1
tasks.note: It ends with its term; the heirs may end it earlier in writing.

tasks.title: Waste fee: new declaration if the fee depends on the number of residents
tasks.title_pl: Opłata za odpady: nowa deklaracja, jeśli opłata zależy od liczby mieszkańców
tasks.law: ustawa o utrzymaniu czystości i porządku w gminach art. 6m ust. 2, art. 2 ust. 3
tasks.note: By the 10th day of the month after the change.
